title: Rumor Points to L.A. Noire Sequel as Rockstar's Post-GTA 6 Project
excerpt:
An anonymous leak suggests Rockstar's next release could revisit L.A. Noire.
Claims about San Francisco, the Zodiac Killer and a 2030 target remain unverified.
body_md:
A ComicBook report has revived an unconfirmed claim about what Rockstar Games might release after GTA 6. Rather than GTA 7, Red Dead Redemption 3 or Bully 2, the rumor points to a possible sequel to the detective game L.A. Noire.

The information traces back to an anonymous source who shared alleged GTA 6 details in September. Some other claims reportedly attracted renewed attention after appearing accurate, but that does not independently establish the credibility of this particular sequel rumor.

According to the unverified account, a new L.A. Noire would move the action to San Francisco and involve an investigation of the Zodiac Killer, the notorious unidentified serial killer associated with the late 1960s. The source also claims a target release year of 2030 and a renewed focus on sophisticated facial-capture technology. None of these details has been officially confirmed.

The original L.A. Noire launched in 2011 and stood out for its interrogation gameplay and facial-animation system. It was developed by Team Bondi and published by Rockstar Games. Team Bondi closed that year, and the franchise has remained largely dormant apart from a later virtual-reality release, The VR Case Files.

Rockstar has not formally announced a sequel, its setting or a release date. Readers should treat the entire report as speculation rather than a confirmed production plan.
